title: One Piece Anime to Continue in 2027, Finished for This Year After Episode 1180
content:
ONE PIECE TV anime announced a 2027 return following the release of Episode 1180 , this year’s final episode, on September 27. The anime has concluded its run for this year, having returned after a 3-month break on April 5. Yuichi Nakamura was revealed as the voice of Loki, and he made his debut in the Elbaph Arc alongside the cast for the Knights of God .

Today’s episode is titled “Elbaph in Despair – Diabolical Covenant, ‘Domi Reversi’” and it is now streaming on Crunchyroll. You can see the end card for the episode below.

ONE PIECE manga by Eiichiro Oda first began in July 1997, and the series exceeded 600 million circulating copies worldwide in March this year. It also celebrated the 25th anniversary in 2022, while the anime adaptation started in October 1999 and is also still going strong.

The anime also debuted new theme songs for the ongoing arc. The opening song’s title is “Luminous,” and it’s performed by AiNA THE END. The ending song is “That Future” by Jisoku 36km.

Upcoming Projects

• A new LEGO special animation project releasing with two episodes on September 29

• Season 3 of the live-action series is set for 2027, having revealed new Alabasta cast recently

• The franchise also has the upcoming remake anime by WIT Studio set to premiere in February 2027

• A new game titled ONE PIECE: Grand Gourmet launching on October 23, 2026

• Two new anime films, with ONE PIECE FILM GOD VALLEY set for Summer 2027 and ONE PIECE FILM BAAD set for 2029

You can vote for your favorite anime every week at polls.animecorner.me .

title: Welcome to Demon School Iruma-kun to Return With New Movie – Watch Teaser
content:
Welcome to Demon School, Iruma-kun has just wrapped up its fourth season, and the franchise has confirmed it’s now in the works on coming back with its feature film debut. The Fall 2026 anime schedule has officially kicked off this week as the earliest premieres are starting to hit, and that means it’s time to say goodbye to all of the shows you might have enjoyed over the Summer. Some of the franchises have been airing since earlier this Spring, so it’s a much bigger goodbye for those shows.

Welcome to Demon School, Iruma-kun is one such series as it had returned for Season 4 of its run earlier this Spring. With two cours now wrapping up with its final episode of the Summer , the anime has thankfully announced it still has plans to continue. But rather than return for another season of the TV anime series, Welcome to Demon School, Iruma-kun has confirmed it’s returning for a new feature film instead. Check out the announcement trailer for it below.

New Welcome to Demon School, Iruma-kun Movie Announced

Welcome to Demon School, Iruma-kun has confirmed it’s now working on its first feature film project, but unfortunately there are currently very few concrete details about what to expect or when to expect. Release window or date details have yet to be announced, nor has it been revealed what potential production staff or voice cast will be attached to the new movie as of this time. This also means any potential word on an international release is much further off from this point too. But it will be tackling a brand new story, however.

Welcome to Demon School, Iruma-kun has confirmed that this new feature film will have a story not seen in the original manga or prior anime releases. One recent trend of anime feature films has been adapting the manga materials into a feature film release instead of more TV anime episodes, so thankfully that doesn’t seem like it’s going to be the case here. For now, it’s best to catch up with everything that’s happened in the first four seasons so far now streaming with Crunchyroll in the meantime.

What’s Next for Iruma-Kun?

Welcome to Demon School, Iruma-kun Season 4 officially capped off Iruma and the Misfit Class’ first year in school, and the final episode saw them officially kick off their second year. They’ve been made a target from the rest of the underworld due to how much they have been accomplishing in such a short time, and it’s clear that their challenges are going to be much harsher from now on. Which is what we’re certainly going to see first hand with this new feature film.

That’s not all that’s in the works for the franchise either. Welcome to Demon School, Iruma-kun is officially celebrating the 10th anniversary of Osamu Nishi’s original manga debut in 2027, and there’s even a new spinoff anime in the works. Welcome to Demon School, Iruma-kun: IruMafia Edition is an alternate universe where Iruma is adopted into a mafia family instead, and will be coming our way sometime next year.

There’s lots to be excited for, but what are you hoping to see from the Welcome to Demon School, Iruma-kun movie? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Killing Bites' Shinya Murata Launches New Fantasy Ninja Manga
content:
Kadokawa announced on Friday Shinya Murata launched a new manga series with Daichi Matsuse titled Shinoblade SHINOBI BLADE in Kadokawa and Kakao Piccoma 's "Manga BAR" e-manga magazine on the same day. Murata will write and storyboard the series while Matsuse will provide the art.

The story follows the strongest female ninja, who operated in Hattori Hanzō's shadow. At the moment she died, she instead found herself transported to another world.

Murata launched the Akujo Ranking (Villainess Ranking) manga with Wakata Wakuta in Kadokawa 's Monthly Dragon Age magazine on March 9.

Murata and Kazasa Sumita launched the Killing Bites manga in Monthly Hero's in March 2017, although it now runs on the Comiplex website. Hero's Inc. published the manga's 27th compiled book volume on June 29. A television anime adaptation premiered on the Animeism programming block on MBS and TBS in January 2018. The anime's unaired "director's cut" streamed worldwide on Amazon Prime Video . The anime had 12 episodes.

Murata and Sumita launched the Saikyō Skill "Inochigoi" de Kuyashii kedo Musō Shichau Moto Ōsama no Sekai Seifuku Katsudō (The Activities of the Former Demon King Whose Strongest Skill is the Embarrassing "Begging for Her Life" and Yet She Will Use it to Run Wild and Conquer the World) manga on Comiplex in June 2023. The manga ended with its fourth volume in December 2025.

Kumo Kagyu and Matsuse launched the Goblin Slayer: A Day in the Life manga in Square Enix 's Monthly Big Gangan magazine in December 2022, and ended the series in November 2024. Square Enix shipped the the manga's third and final volume in February 2025.

Matsuse also drew the I Wish I Could Meet You Again on the Hill Where That Flower Blooms manga with storywriter Natsue Shiomi . Seven Seas Entertainment will release the manga in English starting in December. Matsuse has also drawn the Re:ZERO -Starting Life In Another World- Chapter 1: A Day in the Capital and Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Chapter 3: Truth of Zero manga, both of which Yen Press has released in English.

title: New 'Monster Strike: Mera×Death: Shinigami to Boku no Ijou na Koi' Announced for Winter 2027
content:
Game publisher and developer Mixi announced a new television anime adaptation for the Monster Strike smartphone role-playing game, subtitled Monster Strike: Mera×Death: Shinigami to Boku no Ijou na Koi ( Mera×Death: The Unusual Love Between Me and the Grim Reaper ) on Sunday. The official website also revealed the production staff, a key visual (pictured), and the first promotional video. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on Tokyo MX and other stations on January 5, 2027.

Staff Director: Kenta Kushiya ( Kaijuu 8-gou episode director) Advisor: Takao Kato ( Fuufu Ijou, Koibito Miman. director) Series Composition, Screenplay: Daisuke Oohigashi ( Fate/strange Fake ) Character Design: Tadashi Sakazaki ( Tensei Kizoku, Kantei Skill de Nariagaru ) Prop/Creature Design: Masayuki Honda ( Ao Ashi character design[/i]) Color Design: Azusa Sasaki ( Lycoris Recoil ) Art Setting: Haruka Taira ( Shichisei no Subaru ) Art Director: Norifumi Nakamura ( Kono Kaisha ni Suki na Hito ga Imasu ) CG Director: Asuka Fukada ( Romantic Killer episode director) Director of Photography: Takuma Morooka ( Watashi ga Koibito ni Nareru Wake Nai jan, Muri Muri! (※Muri ja Nakatta!?) ) Editing: Ichirou Chaen ( Kanojo ga Koushaku-tei ni Itta Riyuu ) Sound Director: Fumihiko Ootera ( Tamon-kun Ima Docchi!? ) Sound Production: Magic Capsule ( Dr. Stone: Science Future Part 3 ) Music: Masaru Yokoyama ( Mikadono Sanshimai wa Angai, Choroi. ), Kana Hashiguchi ( Otome Game Sekai wa Mob ni Kibishii Sekai desu ), Natsuki Hamada ( Nigashita Sakana wa Ookikatta ga Tsuriageta Sakana ga Ookisugita Ken ) Music Production: Miracle Bus ( Sousou no Frieren 2nd Season ) Producer: Arch Studio: Qzil.la ( Champignon no Majo ), Studio Keel

Developed by Mixi , Monster Strike was released under its brand XFLAG on iOS in Japan in September 2013 and on Android in December 2013. A North American version debuted in October 2014 but was discontinued in August 2017. The game has over 55 million downloads worldwide.

The first anime series debuted in 51 episodes from October 2015 to December 2016. A second season streamed in 23 episodes from April 2017 to September 2017, followed by the 13-episode third season, Kieyuku Uchuu-hen ( The Fading Cosmos ), from October 2017 to January 2018. A fourth series streamed in 63 episodes from July 2018 to December 2019.

The first anime movie, Hajimari no Basho e ( To The Place of Beginnings ), premiered in theatres in Japan in December 2016, serving as a prequel to the first net anime. The third and latest movie in the franchise, Lucifer - Zetsubou no Yoake , opened in Japan in November 2020.

Synopsis Six years ago, a massive explosion occurred in the town of Ouma, but miraculously, there were no fatalities.

In this city where a mysterious sphere called "Glass Sun" floats in the sky, a boy named Mera Kagari, who feels out of place and lives a boring life, meets a mysterious girl named Thirteen on his 16th birthday.

Her encounter with her brings vibrant colors to Mera's previously monochrome life, but at the same time, strange occurrences begin to unfold in the city.

PV 1

title: One Peace Books Adds 'My Life Turned Around: After I Was Betrayed and Framed, I Won the Heart of the Most Beautiful Girl at School' Manga
content:
One Peace Books describes its story:

The day he lost everything was the day he met her. At the end of summer, Eiji Aono witnesses the unthinkable: his childhood friend and girlfriend, Miyuki Amada, cheating on him with Kondo, the ace of the school's soccer team. Betrayed by the girl he loved, Eiji is left emotionally shattered. As if that weren't enough, he soon becomes the target of vicious rumors and relentless slander for crimes he never committed. With nowhere left to turn, he flees to the rooftop of his school...there, at his lowest point, he meets a mysterious girl who will change his life forever.

The manga adaptation launched on Kadokawa 's Comic Newtype website in June 2025. The first book volume of the manga shipped in November 2025. The second compiled volume launched on June 10.

The manga is based on author D and illustrator Higeneko 's light novel series that launched on Kakuyomu in September 2023. The novel series won two awards in the 9th Kakuyomu Web Novel Contest. Kadokawa began releasing the series in print in November 2024, and shipped the fourth volume on May 29.

title: Monster Strike Franchise Gets New Mera×Death: Shinigami to Boku no Ijō na Koi TV Anime Starting on January 5
content:
MIXI announced on Sunday a new anime in the Monster Strike franchise titled Mera×Death: Shinigami to Boku no Ijō na Koi (Mera×Death: The Unusual Love Between Me and the Grim Reaper), which will debut in Japan on January 5, 2027 on TOKYO MX and 10 other channels, as well as on streaming services.

Kenta Kushitani (episode director for Birdie Wing -Golf Girls' Story- , Shangri-La Frontier , Kaiju No. 8 ) is directing the anime at Qzil.la and studio keel . Daisuke Ōhigashi ( As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill TV 3 , Fate/strange Fake , The Vermillion Mask ) is overseeing and writing the series scripts, and Tadashi Sakazaki ( Zoids Wild Zero , ZOIDS: Chaotic Century , Zoids/ZERO ) is the character designer. Masaru Yokoyama ( Arakawa Under the Bridge two seasons, Hana-Kimi , Mobile Suit Gundam: Iron-Blooded Orphans ), Kana Hashiguchi ( Classroom of the Elite , Young Ladies Don't Play Fighting Games , Botan Kamiina Fully Blossoms When Drunk ), and Natsuki Hamada ( Always a Catch! , Even Though I’m a Super Timid Noble Girl ) are composing the music.

Other staff members include:

• Adviser: Takao Katō

• Props/Creature Designer: Masayuki Honda

• Color Design: Azusa Sasaki

• Art Setting: Haruka Taira (Studio Moe ibara)

• Art Director: Norifumi Nakamura

• CG Director: Asuka Fukada (Moe)

• Compositing Director of Photography: Takuma Morooka (Marco)

• Editing: Ichiro Chaen

• Sound Director: Fumihiko Ōtera

• Sound Production: Magic Capsule

• Music Production: MIRACLE BUS

• Musical Director: Yūya Sasaki

• Production: ARCH

Monster Strike: Deadverse Reloaded , the first anime series based on MIXI 's Monster Strike mobile role-playing game franchise to premiere on broadcast television, debuted in October 2025, and it aired for one cours (quarter of a year) of 10 episodes. Amazon Prime Video added all 10 episodes of the anime in January with English subtitles.

MIXI launched the original game on iOS and Android devices in Japan in 2013, and then launched it in English the next year. However, the English version ended service in 2017. A game debuted on Nintendo 3DS in Japan in 2015.

The first 52-episode net anime season in the franchise, Monster Strike the Animation , premiered in October 2015. (This anime was initially announced for broadcast, but then premiered online.) The first part of the show's second season premiered in April 2017, and ran until September 2017. The 13-episode second part of the second season, titled Monster Strike the Anime: The Fading Cosmos , premiered in October 2017.

The anime's third season premiered in July 2018 and ran for 12 episodes. The franchise then ran five episodes in an Arthur spinoff series, seven episodes in a Lucifer spinoff series, and 13 episodes in a Solomon spinoff series (all of which are considered part of the overall third season of the anime). The Arthur Kishiō no Kakusei ( Arthur (2nd) ) anime premiered in May 2019 and ran for seven episodes, and the Noah Hakobune no Kyūseishu (The Savior of Noah's Arc) anime premiered in July 2019 and ran for six episodes. Lucifer: The Final Arc ( Lucifer Wedding Game ) premiered with English subtitles in October 2020 and ran for seven episodes.

The net anime's final arc, Monster Strike : End of the World , premiered in November 2019 on YouTube .

The Hareruya: Unmei no Sentaku (Hareruya: Fated Choice) anime streamed online in September 2020 on YouTube , Twitter Live, and Abema TV . The anime is the franchise's first "interactive anime": viewers were able to choose between two options to decide how the last 10 minutes of the anime would play out.

The first Monster Strike The Movie anime film opened in Japan in December 2016. Crunchyroll began streaming the film in May 2017. The second film in the franchise, Monster Strike The Movie: Sora no Kanata (Beyond the Sky), opened in Japan in October 2018. The Monster Strike the Movie: Lucifer Dawn of Despair ( Monster Strike The Movie: Lucifer Zetsubō no Yoake ) film opened in November 2020 after delays , and Crunchyroll streamed the film in August 2021.

title: 'Mairimashita! Iruma-kun' Anime Movie Announced
content:
The Mairimashita! Iruma-kun ( Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun ) special event "Devils Party 2" announced an anime movie project for the franchise on Sunday. The official website also revealed an announcement image (pictured above) and announcement promo.

Produced by Bandai Namco Pictures , the first season aired in 23 episodes in Fall 2019. The second and third seasons ran for 21 episodes in Spring 2021 and Fall 2022, respectively. The 24-episode fourth season premiered on April 4 and concluded on September 26. Crunchyroll simulcast the television anime series with subtitles worldwide, excluding Asia.

A television anime adaptation of the spin-off manga Mairimashita! Iruma-kun: if Episode of Mafia was announced for a January 2027 premiere.

Mairimashita! Iruma-kun adapts Osamu Nishi 's demon comedy manga , which began serializing in Weekly Shounen Champion in March 2017. Akita Shoten released the 50th volume on September 8. The series has over 20 million cumulative copies of its volumes in circulation.

Kodansha USA licensed the manga in English in July 2022 and published the 21th volume on August 4. The 22th volume is scheduled for an October 6 release.

Announcement
author: MyAnimeList

title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun First Theatrical Anime Film Project Announced
content:
Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun is getting its first theatrical anime film project. The project announcement video was revealed during the DEVIL’S PARTY! 2 event held at Nippon Engineering College Arena in Tokyo on September 27.

Ayumu Murase, who voices Iruma Suzuki, shared the following comment:

“I think it’s going to develop into something that makes you wonder, ‘What’s going to happen!?’ I’m really looking forward to it myself, and I hope everyone will come out to see it as well. For now, I’ll do my best with the recording, so please look forward to it!”

Series creator Osamu Nishi also commented:

“More than anything, I’m really looking forward to it. I’ve been told by the people around me not to say anything, so I can’t really say anything (laughs), but we’re working very hard on it, so I hope you’ll wait patiently.”

You can watch the announcement video below.

The Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun anime is based on Osamu Nishi’s manga serialized in Weekly Shonen Champion , which has 50 volumes published as of September 8, 2026. The anime premiered in 2019. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime, describing the story: Suzuki Iruma, human, 14, one day finds himself taken against his will into the world of demons. To add to his predicament, his doting owner and self-appointed “Grandpa” is the chair-demon at his new school. In order to survive, Iruma must deal with a haughty student who challenges him to a duel, a girl with adjustment issues, and so many more scary beings! Can this ultimate pacifist dodge the slings and arrows that are flung his way? As he struggles frantically, Iruma’s innate kindness begins to win over enemies.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Welcome to Demon School, Iruma-kun' Anime Unveils 1st Film Project
content:
The "DEVIL'S PARTY! 2" special event for the anime of Osamu Nishi 's Welcome to Demon School, Iruma-kun ( Mairimashita! Iruma-kun ) manga announced in a promotional video on Sunday that the anime's first film project is launching. The video teases that the film will tell a brand-new story. The video also celebrated the upcoming 10th anniversary of the original manga next year.

The story of Mairimashita! Iruma-kun follows Iruma, a kind-hearted 14-year-old boy whose parents sell him to demons for their own selfish interests. However, the demon he is sold to has no grandson of his own, so he dotes on Iruma and sends him to demon school.

The anime's fourth season premiered on April 4 on NHK Educational at 6:25 p.m. JST. The season ran for two cours (quarters of a year), and ended with its 24th episode on Saturday. The anime streamed in Japan starting on April 6. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, the CIS, and India.

The anime's third season debuted in October 2022. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired, and also streamed an English dub .

The second season premiered in April 2021. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired, and debuted an English dub in June 2021.

The anime's first season premiered in October 2019 on NHK Educational , and had 23 episodes. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan under the title Welcome to Demon School, Iruma-kun , and also streamed an English dub .

Nishi launched the manga in Akita Shoten 's Weekly Shōnen Champion magazine in March 2017.
author: ANN

title: We Are Aliens Film, Eri Short Anime, Candy Caries Win at Ottawa Int'l Animation Festival
content:
NOTHING NEW 's We Are Aliens ( Ware Ware wa Uchūjin ) anime film , Honami Yano 's Eri animated short , and Tomoki Misato and Wit Studio 's original television anime Candy Caries were all awarded at the 50th Anniversary Awards Ceremony of the Ottawa International Animation Festival, on Saturday. We Are Aliens won the Grand Prize for Animated Feature, Eri won the Best Animated Short Award, and Candy Caries won at the Animation for Young Audiences 7+ Competition.

We Are Aliens opened in Japan on Friday. Kōhei Kadowaki directed the film. The film screened at the Directors' Fortnight of the Cannes Film Festival on May 14, and screened in competition at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival, which ran from June 21 to 27. Aside from the Ottawa International Film Festival (OIAF), the Melbourne International Film Festival (MIFF) and the New Zealand International Film Festival (NZIFF) also screened the film. The film will screen in the "Japanese Animation Special: Masterpieces of Madness, Exhilarating Prospects 12+1" category of the 31st Busan International Film Festival (BIFF), which will take place on October 6-15.

Kadowaki, who created the second BEASTARS season's ending sequence and music videos for YOASOBI , served as the film's planner, scriptwriter, director, storyboard artist, and editor. Yaffle — who previously produced music for Fujii Kaze, Kenshi Yonezu , and others — composed the music. NOTHING NEW planned and produced the film, and French studio Miyu Productions ( Ghost Cat Anzu , A New Dawn ) collaborated on the production, after joining on the project in June 2025. adieu performs the film's theme song "Sasakure" (Split).

Director Honami Yano describes Eri :

In a world where dairy cows must bear calves to survive, Eri, a Holstein, falls in love with another cow. Her sighs linger through sleepless nights — will they find their way to the one she loves?

Yano ( A Bite of Bone , ChromosomeSweetheart ) wrote the script, animated, and directed the Japanese-French production Eri short. It is an adaptation of Kasumi Asakura's 2008 Hoka ni Dare ga iru ( Who Else is There? ) novel. The short had its world premiere at the Directors' Fortnight of the Cannes Film Festival held on May 14.

The Candy Caries original television anime premiered within the Yoru no Brunch variety program on TBS on April 15. Amazon Prime Video streams the anime.

Misato ( Pui Pui Molcar ) and Wit Studio are credited for the original work. Misato is directing the series at TORUKU from WIT STUDIO . Kenshirō Morii ( Anime-Gataris , Grand Blues! ) serves as assistant director. Chiaki Nishiaka ( The Ancient Magus' Bride , Shinkalion Change the World ) writes the script and Akari Saitō ( Etotama , Spy×Family ) edits the series. Keigo Hoashi ( Summer Time Rendering , Dusk maiden of Amnesia ) composes the music.

The Candy Caries anime is a slapstick comedy about Ame, a child who loves sweets, and the tooth decay that lives in her mouth called Caries. Caries lives a carefree life inside Ame's mouth and even calls her "Mama," and Ame's body is always at Caries' mercy.

Candy Caries was first revealed as a stop-motion anime promotional video in 2021 after Wit Studio had established a stop-motion studio with Misato in December 2020.

According to Misato, he used plastic board and acrylic for Candy Caries , and describes it as a semi three-dimensional animation that's "flat like an illustration, but plump and thick."
author: ANN
